formal_boundary.statement: Smallest decision-changing target is the quotient comparison: for a linear map pi on Z, given kernelU, imageV_K=IK, imageM=Tmem and explicit surjectivity, prove induced Z/(U+V_K+M) ≃ ((I∩K)/IK)/Tmem. The Lean theorem must expose these as hypotheses and may not claim the polynomial certificates establish them. Independent QA checks semantic correspondence; known-false control drops kernel condition and must fail using a noninjective map between a two-element space and a singleton. Formal runtime dependency pins are absent and are a concrete activation prerequisite.
formal_boundary.representation: Lean core Setoid/Quotient model: type Z with declared explained equivalence E, target type T with declared equivalence Tmem, and pi. Hypotheses state surjectivity modulo Tmem and that pi(z1)~pi(z2) iff z1~E z2. Prove induced quotient map is well-defined, injective and surjective, retaining exact hypotheses. Polynomial linear-map/kernel/intersection premises are independently certified, not proved by this abstract lemma.
formal_boundary.pin_basis: Actual committed formal/smoke/lean-toolchain and empty manifest read. Use an isolated experiment-specific core-only project, not absent root Mathlib pins.
formal_boundary.positive_control: Actual complete quotient-comparison proposition with both directions of kernel equivalence.
formal_boundary.known_false_control: Dropping converse kernel equivalence permits a two-element source modulo equality mapping constantly to a singleton; a claimed injectivity theorem under weaker hypotheses must be rejected.
formal_boundary.activation: Separate formal source/toolchain/manifest snapshot and input hashes, actual executable version match, exact theorem transitive axiom audit; no sorryAx/custom axioms/unsafe. Allowed standard axioms only propext,Classical.choice,Quot.sound. Source build is not semantic review.
formal_boundary.concrete_polynomial_gate: UNMET by the abstract Lean result alone. A separate independent concrete algebraic proof and per-instance full kernel/image/certificate checks must discharge the actual polynomial pi/U/IK/Tmem premises. No machine-verified label for Z/E or Tor follows from this scaffold. Any later concrete formal theorem needs its own complete frozen statement and actual dependency pins.
